text:
sam: Hey team — need a favor. I have a family thing Saturday evening. Can someone cover oncall 18:00–02:00 UTC? I can swap for a weekday next week. Quick notes: canary deploy at 19:15 UTC (service: inference-api-canary), new quantized model cache warmup running, route fallback enabled. DB compaction currently scheduled ~01:30 UTC (I can ask to move if needed). Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/oncall/handbook#canary. TL;DR: if latency >300ms for 2+ minutes, escalate to eng-oncall and roll back canary. cc @maria @alex

maria: I can take 18:00–22:30 UTC. Remote but reachable. I'll watch the 19:15 canary. If cache warmup causes >50% token timeouts, @maria should be pinged (will respond). :thumbsup:

alex: I can pick up 22:15–02:00 if we do a 22:15–22:30 overlap for handoff. I won't be on the phone after 00:30 but will monitor Slack/alerts. @sam can you move the DB compaction or confirm devops can shift it?

oncall-bot: Rotation update — alex assigned 22:30–02:00. Reminder: please set status /oncall when taking handoff.

devops: FYI — bumped DB compaction to 03:00 UTC to avoid the evening canary. There may be a short IO spike around 03:00; we'll annotate metrics.

maria: small runbook checklist: 1) tail proxy logs: `kubectl -n prod logs -f inference-proxy --tail=100` 2) check Grafana panel `http_requests_latency` and the canary/primary error rates 3) rollback command if needed: `./scripts/roll-back-canary.sh` 4) if service errors >5% for 5m, escalate.

sam: thanks — I'll update the runbook with handoff times and the overlap. Alex, confirm final handoff at 22:30? I'll post a last status update 15m before I leave.

alex: confirmed, will be online 22:25 UTC for handoff. Good luck, thanks for arranging the swap. :raised_hands:
